nom: COSRX The Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizer For Sensitive Skin

avis.texte: I love this stuff so much! I bought it on a whim dueing one of the 21 days of beauty and I am so glad I did! I only wish it was available in a larger size. It is the perfect feeling of not heavy but not so light that it feels pointless. My skin feels just right when I apply this.

This is the perfect every day moisturizer for my sensitive skin. I was struggling with perioral dermatitis and was trying to figure out what was going on and where it was coming from. Turns out it was my vichy moisturizer…. I received a sample of this and it purchased a full size right after. It has completely healed my skin barrier. Its not too rich or too thin its the perfect consistency.
I was so surprised at how nice this was! My sensitive, dry skin soaks this up. Love that it's unscented and will definitely be repurchasing.

i love this moisturizer! in just a few weeks the overall health of my skin has improved so much. i also love that a little bit goes a long way, so ik it's gonna last forever, and it doesnt feel too heavy on the skin. perfect for anyone with dry/acne prone/sensitive skin!

I love Kiehl's Facial Cream with Squalane, but really could not justify the price. This feels so similar. The texture is thick like the Kiehl's and absorbs so well. There is no weird stickiness or texture after application. This is my new go to.
I bought this entire line of product and this particular product is very hydrating and lightweight at the same time. I love it. It really locks in moisture.
I bought this entire line of product and I have to say my skin has never been more hydrated or Glass like in my life definitely recommend
I switched to this moisturizer cause I needed a more affordable option. I have now switched over cause its so thick and nurishing for my dry skin. A little bit goes a long way!

Tbis is hands down the best skincare product I've ever used! I've been dealing with perioral dermatitis for the past couple of months and this product is the only thing that has completely healed my skin barrier; giving me a long lasting glow and softer skin! If you struggle with PD or dry skin, you NEED to try this!!
This lotion does exactly what it says it will. It provides a great barrier without being too heavy. It has zero smell, zero irritation. Mild and effective.

avis.titre: Finally found THE perfect moisturizer for dry skin
avis.texte: I have been using/trying many, many moisturizers over the past few years. This one is perfect. It is rich, doesn't sit on the surface, yet doesn't make my skin feel parched in an hour after applying. Plays well with foundation too!

This is an amazing moisturizer!!! I love this product! I got a free one from ulta beauty world 2025 and have purchased it after because its so great. The quality of this product is phenomenal and the scientists behind this formula deserve a raise!!!

I bought this to treat irritation from a damaged skin barrier and saw the results immediately! The feel is silky smooth and not too heavy! More than just an occlusive, it is actually hydrating and cleared up the irritation completely. Will buy again!!
I use a lot on my skin. Always looking for the next thing to improve it. This has been a lifesaver for flakes and redness and just smoothed my skin out. I won't be without it!

This is too heavy and occlusive for regular use on my skin, it makes me break out if used too often or use too much product, i have sensative and acne prone skin. But i keep it in my drawer incase i need deep moisture or healing which its amazing at
This is my absolute new favorite moisturizer. It just melts into my skin and is so hydrating. Im so happy i decided to buy it.
100000/10. This is a gnetle moisturizer that my sensitive skin LOVES. Perfect for am, pm, or post treatment use.

As I'm aging, my skin is getting dryer, but I still have to watch out for blocked pores and breakouts. So fun! This moisturizer is great for dry skin, but it definitely caused me to breakout. I think I had four or five little spots once by the end of the day after applying. I gave it a few days to see if my skin adjusted, but ended up stopping use. I know they say it's non-comedogenic tested, but be cautious on this one if you're prone to breakouts.

avis.titre: A Staple for skin barrier health!
avis.texte: This moisturizer has been healing my sensitive acne prone skin with it's rich ceramide, cholesterol and fatty acid formula. I chose this over the Aestura cream because they're similar in purpose and it's been tested to be safe for all skin types especially sensitive, dry and acne prone. Also beats the Aestura in price. It has a lightweight body that still seals in hydration with it's light emollience from the dimethicone. You dont need more than a nickel size amount as it easily spreads. It's not greasy, it leaves a natural radiant finish and soothes the skin. I dont buy a product without doing at least some research and when i saw Kelly Driscoll on YouTube reviewing this, i had to try it and i Definitely recommend!

avis.titre: Needed something thicck for the cold weather
avis.texte: I have dry skin and it's hard to find something that's thick that doesn't pill under makeup but this moisturizer is great and leaves my skin super soft at night, will be purchasing again.

I have sensitive combination skin and was excited to try this based on reviews. Unfortunately, I find it to be extremely greasy and it does not sink in or dry down hours after applying. My skin is left looking wet and feels sticky to the touch. Maybe this would work okay as a night cream but it is definitely too greasy for daytime use. I like other Cosrx products so this is disappointing.

avis.titre: Amazing Moisturizer at a Phenomenal Price
avis.texte: I've been on the search for years for a good overnight moisturizer. My skin becomes very dry in the winter months but is still slightly too oily for an extra-rich moisturizer during the day. I started using this at night a couple months ago and it's my new favorite. My skin wakes up feeling so refreshed and soft and it also looks great. My new go-to for overnight barrier support. I've tried using it during the day under my makeup and that wasn't the right use for me. My face was super oily/greasy by the end of the day and a lot of my makeup had rubbed off. So just be careful if your skin is like mine and you're thinking about using this twice a day. Once a day is the perfect schedule for my skin. Will be purchasing over and over and over again.
This moisturizer is very good if your looking for something light and not a heavy moisturizer.

I was so excited because I LOVE the texture of this. It comes out pretty thick but goes on thin. After a couple days of patch testing on my upper lip and chin, I started noticing my face turns red and hot right after I apply. I wish this worked for me!

Great moisturizer for day or evening use. It goes on so good and doesn't make you feel greasy. I have dry skin in the winter and this is the best. I am new to this brand but love it so far amd have seen an improvement in my skin after 6 weeks of use!
I have combination and acne prone skin. I needed a thicker moisturizer for the colder months, and this product has been great. My skin feels soft and I haven't broken out.

I haven't been using for long. May need to update. Only haven't been using about a week. I like the texture and consistency. Ive only used one other barrier cream and it had more of a petroleum jelly consistency. This is more of a cream. I have red angry sensitive skin. This does not make it worse. Im hoping in time it will make it better.
Lightweight Feel: Despite being rich, it absorbs well without feeling heavy or greasy. Good for Cold Weather. A budget-friendly option compared to luxury alternatives

Bought this one to try out after damaging my skin barrier all other moisturizers were only causing more acne and oil build up. I have dry skin but "hydrating moisturizers" tend to be oily and this one is perfect!! Actually hydrates skin calms any redness and feels light.

Within days of using this, my skin is the softest and smoothest it has ever been. I use it at night after washing my face and I wake up with wonderful results. I have my husband and son using it now. 10/10, must try.

avis.titre: Very Similar to the Ordinary's Natural Moisturizing Factors
avis.texte: I've been using the Ordinary's Natural Moisturizing Factors for YEARS, but after liking other COSRX products decided to give this a try. VERY similar! Lightweight and unscented, good for my combo skin. I would say it feels slightly drier than the Ordinary, maybe a bit more matte. I will however stick with the Ordinary because it's half the price of COSRX.

this stuff is incredible. I did some serious damage to my skin with a product that contains AHAs and this moisturizer repaired my damaged skin barrier. I have extremely sensitive, dry skin and its worked incredibly well.

I saw this moisturizer and had to try it. The best face moisturizer I have ever used. I have a combination, with rosacea, dry cheeks in the winter kind of skin. In the past few weeks I've used it morning and night. There is no irritation and my skin absorbs it so easily. It does not peel. It feels so light and not sticky at all. My absolute favorite moisturizer of all time.

this is probably my first and only ever review on this app for a skin care product. I am acne prone and have tried everything from luxury to drug store and I think its safe to say that this is the only moisturizer that does what it promises to do! My skin barrier healed over night and left zero residue as someone with oily skin. K-beauty really is saving the skin care industry! THANK YOU

Bought this because i was desperate for a moisturizer that wasnt going to break out and wouldn't burn. I sometimes use too many different acids on my face and everything burns. Usually cream moisturizers would turn me off as an oily skin girly, but this cream is so lightweight and an amazing night moisturizer for me. I will definitely repurchase. Officially one of my favorite COSRX products now

avis.titre: If I could bathe in it I would
avis.texte: I wish this came in a liter sized tube so i could slather my entire body in it! Best moisturizer i've ever used hands down. COSRX should make more products in this line!

I am an acne prone/ combo / oily skin. Im so happy I purchased it after reading some really good reviews! This has high rating on ingredients on "Yuka", sets into my skin really well, does its job with moisturising, and does not break me out or make me oily. Highly recommend!

So moisturizing and actually penetrates and blends into the skin!! My makeup looks so much better after using this product. I have extremely dry skin and have tried dozens of skincare brands. I received a sample of this and after using it up had to go get the full size. The price is great for the quality!

I really like this product i wear it on the daily under my sunscreen because its a bit thicker but when i do my makeup i go for a lighter moisturizer.Overall great product if you want to try a new moisturizer.

avis.titre: Seemed great on paper but broke me out
avis.texte: I have combination acne prone skin and this moisturizer clogged my pores and worsened existing acne, such a bummer because it did feel nourishing on the skin

avis.titre: I hope cosrx never gets rid of this product ￼
avis.texte: I finally found the best moisturizer ever. I hope it never runs out of stock.
I use this in the AM after VitC. Winter dryness is a thing where I live. Doesn't make you oily.
It is the best moisturizer I have ever used. I gave two to my friends and they really like it.
Lightweight & highly moisturizing! I love that it protects my skin and doesnt feel heavy! Definitely restocking on this. I have used it for 3 weeks now.

I take an oral ceramide supplement but wanted to boost my ceramides topically. I use this at night, layered over a standard moisturizer so my skin can get a deep moisture treatment while I rest. I really like this a lot--when I wake up, my skin isn't dry and feels plump. I have been using this for a few weeks and will keep it in the rotation!
First try for this product. It's light and doesn't pill off my way like a lot of moisturizers do. I like that it protects my skin!

I absolutely love the Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizer. When using a retinol or tretinoin product, I start with a layer of snail mucin, then layer retinol mixed with cica cream, and top it off with this ceramide cream. It's super moisturizing and has been fantastic at preventing the retinol uglies.
This moisturizer is really nice. My skin stays hydrated all day!
This moisturizer is a holy grail for sensitive skin, especially in the humid summer! It is lightweight and non-greasy, light hydrating and rich.

I love this new addition to my skincare routine! It really locks in moisture and makes my skin feel soft and supple. A little goes a long way so it's a great bang for your buck. I have sensitive skin and have trouble with moisturizers at night. This caused no issues overnight so I can use it any time. It makes my skin feel so smooth and diminishes redness. This is definitely a new must have for me.
I use trentinoin, which can be very drying. This helps keep my skin moisturize.

avis.titre: Enjoyed the moisturizer but not my fav for the price
avis.texte: I'm only taking off a star because I have similar moisturizers from 2 other brands that are close in size and ingredients but are priced lower. It doesn't stand out a lot from the other two I have but I'll definitely buy this again if it goes on sale. I enjoyed the texture and how it melted into my skin and was hydrating. I have sensitive skin so it's picky about what I put on it and it approved of this one.
This moisturizer is perfect for my combination skin. I actually feel it restores my skin barrier and protects it after use. Will definitely make this a regular buy and recommend.
I like how it melts into the skin and is very hydrating with no smell.
This goes on very smoothly and makes my skin so soft and supple!

I had damaged my skin barrier. It was dry and burned when I washed it. I bought this product and it instantly soothed my skin, went on smooth and non-greasy. After two days I was sold and have been using it ever since. A little goes a long way! You will not be disappointed!
My face feels well moisturized. . not thirsty at all! And definitely not too thick or greasy.

I have extremely sensitive and dehydrated skin, even rainwater irritates my skin! This moisturizer is the only moisturizer that comes through and hydrates my skin. I've tried every moisturizer from the cheapest and most expensive, and this one is by far my favorite!
This moisturizer is so refreshing, it feels so nice on the skin. It keeps me so hydrated which my skin is always in need of. I would recommend this to anyone who asks.
I love this moisturizer and the benefits it has. It's not heavy and feels like it melts into our skin.

LOVE adding this on top of the HA intensive cream as an extra layer of moisture. It is EXTREMELY moisturizing and makes my skin feel so soft. I work in an environment that is very cold and dry which leaves my skin feeling tight and dehydrated. This cream completely remedied that for me by forming a hydrating barrier that lasts all day!

I tried all the viral moisturizers and they all burned my skin, left it feeling red and hot! Finally this one came in to save the day. My redness finally calmed down and I look forward to putting on moisturizer every evening :) I'm so so so in love!!!!!!
So creamy and silky. Feels great - luxurious but not too heavy!
Great moisturizer, works well for my dry skin during the day. Wears well under makeup!

This COSRX Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizer has a healing effect...it's amazing! I use this at night and my skin feels wonderful in the morning. My daughter started to use this too, and she hasn't given the tube back thank you COSRX

The ceramide skin barrier moisturizer is a true skin saver. From the first application, my skin felt instantly soothe and deeply hydrated. If your skin needs a hydration boost and barrier support, this moisturizer is a must have in your routine.
This is a fantastic moisturiser that gives skin an even tone and leaves skin feeling nourished and cared for . It has a rich moisturising element. I would definitely recommend

What a lovely moisturiser. It's so lightweight and non greasy. A little goes a long way to. I've been using it for the past 3 weeks and it is helping to hydrate my skin. After using at night the next morning my skin feels so silky smooth without it creating excess oil. I have combination skin where the areas around my mouth and nose get dry. This cream is helping to soften and stop the dryness. It does not have fragrance added in it. Some of the key ingredients are: Hyaluronic acid Panthenol Squalane Ceramides It's dermatologically tested, hypoallergenic, pediatrician tested and non-comedogenic. I particularly like how light and non greasy this moisturiser is.
I really like this moisturizer because hydrates my skin very well.

Top tier night time moisturizer. Works in the day too, but in the summer it's a bit heavy. Definitely improved my skin texture and redness, I paired it with the 6 peptide booster as well. Will be buying again!
i have super dry skin that can get very tight throughout the day. this product has helped me not only look hydrated but FEEL hydrated

Cosrx has done wonders for my skin since I started using it. I don't think I will ever switch to any other product. My skin isn't dry anymore it's always moisturized. The only thing I'm trying to work on is the discoloration on my skin under my chin from tweezing and I just bought a dark skin corrector from there for it.

Supppper moisturizing but it sits heavy underneath my makeup. I only use concealer and not foundation when I use this moisturizer. My face feels supple and dewey all day. I have combination acne prone skin.
I use it as evening moisturizer because of its richness. But it can also be very effective on dry days - to give the skin protection against weather.
Absolutely amazing to use after Retinol at night. Keeping the skin nice and hydrated as retinol can be drying. Wake up in the morning and your face feels smooth. Highly recommend.

As usual, my order came very fast. So far, this is the best moisturizer ive ever used for my skin, even from this brand. My face feels so smooth and it doesn't burn at all! Hoping to have even better results in the future!! Would highly recommend!

I don't normally use anything to heavy, but I was experiencing some dryness on my face due to weather change and the Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizer realy helped nourish my skin. I love it! The packaging is simple, which I like. It's a great product and urge others to try it.

I just started using this and I think my barrier is already repairing after going a little too hard with retinol. My skin drinks this up and stays soft all day. Shipping was fast and service has been great so far.
This moisturizer stays longer period of time on my face. Makes my skin so soft and hydrated. Small amount goes a long way.
Like this so far. Feels super moisturizing and not heavy on my skin.

avis.titre: My skin has never been happier.
avis.texte: I'm in love! This is THE best moisturizer for me. I have really dry sensitive, acne prone, eczema skin. This stuff is amazing. I put it on at night an hour before bed and in the morning my skin is sooo soft, hydrated and happy. I genuinely like the thick consistency, it may be a bit greasy but my skin loves it! My only conplaint would be the price.
I love this and all of your products. I originally order the booster and toner. From those being great, I went ahead and ordered my entire skin care system from beginning to end. Love it
Certainly hydrating, a bit thick for my skin and under makeup.
I love this creamy formula and so does my face. It has calmed my dry skin.
I use this moisturizer at the end of my skincare routine. It goes on quite thick and feels thick on my skin. It usually leaves my face feeling oily.
Great follow up to the ceramide cream. Love that it has hyaluronic acid in it which my skin really likes.
Lotion is nice and moisturizing without feeling to oily or greasy. It's just the right middle ground for my skin type.

i moved to new york 4 yrs ago and my skin quickly changed after the first winter. i struggled for YEARS with super dry skin (normally oily)- it would literally peel almost every day during the winter. i have used the ceramic skin barrier moisturizer for two weeks (at night only) and omg what a difference it has already made. my face no longer peels!!! i couldn't recommend this more!!
I use this during the day and the overnight rice mask at night love the way both make my skin feel.

This winter really got me & I realized I was using a wash that was too harsh on my skin , it literally , hurt. & it was red & irritated. I was in dire need of something to repair my skin barrier ( is what I learned the issue was ) - this moisturizer was a life saver. My skin is 100x better ! So helpful.
I just brought that moisturizer, I like to keep my face moist specially at night. Hopefully I'm gonna love it.

So far so good! I was using a different brand ceramide moisturizer but wanted to try this new product. Definitely comparable and didn't cause any adverse skin reactions. I saw the same glow and felt moisturized into the next day. I would buy again!
I love this product. I love all of your products that I have tried. They all do exactly what they are advertised to do which is very rare. Thank you!
The Most Perfect product to put on skin after their serum; esp fresh out of a shower. Makes a perfect base for sunscreen or light tinted moisturizer. Not greasy; most absorbent.
